CHAPTER 3 · ITEM 07 / 08

Gains and terms of trade

Production versus consumption生產與消費

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Recognize that trade can allow consumption beyond an individual producer's own PPF; aggregate production still uses available resources and technology.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

交易擴大個人可消費組合，但不會自動改變技術。個人消費可在自己的 PPF 外，整體生產仍受資源限制。

Trade changes consumption possibilities without automatically changing production technology. Individual consumption can lie outside an individual's PPF, while economy-wide production remains feasible and total consumption respects total available goods.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A trades part of its specialized output for B's good. A consumes a mix it cannot efficiently produce alone, while aggregate goods still equal production. 交換重新分配既有商品。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A consumes outside its own PPF after trade. What follows? 交易後消費在個人 PPF 外，代表什麼？
